马车飞快的在小路上驰骋，王林的身子随着地面的坑洼起伏晃动，他抱着怀里的包裹，内心跌宕，带着父母对他的期望，离开了居住十五年的山村。
此地距离县城有不短的路程，王林渐渐睡下，也不知过了多久，他被人轻轻推动，睁开眼睛一看，四叔面带微笑的望着他，打趣道：“铁柱，第一次离开家门，有什么感想啊。”
王林察觉到马车已经停下，憨笑道：“没啥感想，就是有些害怕，不知道能不能被仙人收入。”
四叔哈哈一笑，拍了拍铁柱肩膀，说道：“行了，别想那么多了，到地方了，这是四叔家，你先去休息，等早上我带去你家族。”
下了马车后，展现在王林面前的是一片瓦房，跟着四叔来到一处房间，王林坐在床上却怎么也没有睡意，他脑中闪过一幕幕爹娘、乡亲、亲戚的言语，内心轻叹，对于被仙人收入弟子的念头，更重了。
时间一点点过去，不大一会天色微亮，日头渐渐升起，王林尽管一夜没怎么休息，但精神却很充沛，带着一丝忐忑，他随着四叔来到了王氏家族的大宅子。
这是王林第一次看到这么大的房子，眼花缭乱，四叔边走边叹道：“铁柱，这次一定要给你爹争口气，可别叫亲戚们笑话。”
王林内心更加紧张，紧咬下唇，点了点头。
不大一会儿，四叔把他领到宅子正中的大院子里，铁柱他爹的大哥，那个老者站在院中，看到铁柱后略点头，说道：“铁柱，一会仙人来了，可别大惊小怪，一切事情就跟着你哥哥王卓学，他怎么做，你就怎么做，知道么！”
最后几个字，老者语气严厉。
王林沉默不语，四下一看，发现除了王卓之外，还有一个少年，少年皮肤略黑，虎头虎脑，眼中更是透出一丝机灵，他衣内鼓鼓，好似揣了什么东西。
他看到铁柱望向自己，冲他做了个鬼脸，跑过来问道：“你就是二叔家的铁柱哥吧，我叫王浩。”
王林轻笑，点了点头。
老者看到铁柱居然不理会自己，心底微恼，正要喝斥。
就在这时，忽然天上云彩飘扬，一道剑光闪电般破空而来，剑光消散后，地面上站立一白衣青年，青年目光炯炯有神，散发出飘逸不凡的气质，他神态冰冷，目光在铁柱等三少年身上一扫，尤其是在机灵少年身上鼓鼓之物处看了眼，冷声道：“王家的三个名额，就是他们？”
“这就是仙人？”对方一眼之下，王林只感觉身体一凉，心脏止不住的狂跳，小脸面无血色，呆呆的望着对方。
再看那个一脸机灵之色的少年，也是双手放在裤边，毕恭毕敬，眼中露出狂热之色。
唯有王卓，漫不经心的看了对方一眼，鼻子里轻哼一声。

王卓的父亲连忙上前，满脸恭敬之色，寒蝉若惊道：“上仙，这三人正是王家推荐的族人。”
青年点头，不耐烦的说道：“谁是王卓？”
老者面上一喜，连忙拉着王卓说道：“上仙，这就是犬子王卓。”
青年深深的看了王卓一眼，面色微缓，点头道：“王师弟果然一表人才，难怪能被道虚师叔看中。”
王卓得意的看了看铁柱与另外那个机灵少年，自傲的说道：“那是自然，本少的修仙灵根，道虚仙人可是夸奖不已。”
青年眉头一皱，但很快就舒展开，似笑非笑的望了王卓一眼，袖子一卷，带着三个少年腾云驾雾化作长虹，瞬间消失在原地。
四叔抬头望着天空，喃喃自语道：“铁柱，一定要被选中啊！”
王林感觉身子一轻，剧烈的罡风吹的脸上生痛，仔细一看，立刻震惊的发现自己居然被夹在青年的腋下，正在空中飞快前行，地面的村庄变成一个个巴掌大的黑点，飞快的向后移动。
就这么一小会儿，他的眼睛就已经被风吹的通红，眼泪哗哗流下。
“你们三个不想眼睛瞎掉，就闭眼。”青年冰冷的声音传来。王林内心一颤，连忙闭上双眼，不敢再看，内心对于修仙，更加的向往了。
时间不长，王林能感觉到青年略有气喘，速度也明显降了下来，接着眼前一花，青年迅速落下，在落地的一刻，青年松开手臂，三个少年摔落在地。
好在摔落的力道不重，三人连忙爬起，展现在王林面前的，是一处宛如世外桃源般的仙境，青山绿水，鸟语花香。

The carriage galloped quickly on the road, and Wang Lin's body swayed with the potholes on the ground. He held the package in his arms, his heart was filled with ups and downs, and he left the mountain village where he had lived for fifteen years with his parents' expectations for him.
This place is a long way from the county seat. Wang Lin gradually fell asleep. I don't know how long it took. He was gently pushed by someone. When he opened his eyes, his fourth uncle looked at him with a smile and joked: "Tie Zhu, how do you feel when you leave home for the first time?"
Wang Lin noticed that the carriage had stopped and said with a naive smile: "I don't have any thoughts, I'm just a little scared. I don't know if I can be taken in by the immortal."
The fourth uncle laughed, patted Tie Zhu on the shoulder, and said, "Okay, don't think so much, we are here. This is the fourth uncle's house. You go and rest first, and I will take you to your family in the morning."
After getting off the carriage, what appeared in front of Wang Lin was a tile-roofed house. He followed his fourth uncle to a room. Wang Lin was sitting on the bed but could not sleep at all. Scenes of words from his parents, villagers, and relatives flashed through his mind, and he sighed inwardly. The thought of being accepted as a disciple by the immortal became even more serious.
Time passed little by little, and after a while, the sky became slightly brighter and the sun gradually rose. Although Wang Lin didn't get much rest all night, he was full of energy. With a bit of anxiety, he followed his fourth uncle to the Wang family's mansion.
This was Wang Lin's first time seeing such a big house, and he was dazzled. His fourth uncle sighed as he walked: "Tie Zhu, you must give your father some credit this time, and don't make your relatives laugh."
Wang Lin became even more nervous, bit his lower lip and nodded.
After a while, his fourth uncle led him to the big courtyard in the middle of the house. Tie Zhu's father's eldest brother, the old man, was standing in the courtyard. When he saw Tie Zhu, he nodded slightly and said, "Tie Zhu, the immortal will come in a while, so don't make a fuss. Just follow your brother Wang Zhuo in everything. Whatever he does, you do it, you know!"
The old man's tone was stern in the last few words.
Wang Lin was silent. He looked around and found that besides Wang Zhuo, there was also a young man. The young man had slightly dark skin, a tiger-like head, and a hint of cleverness in his eyes. There was a bulge in his clothes, as if he was carrying something.
He saw Tie Zhu looking at him, made a face at him, ran over and asked, "Are you brother Tie Zhu from my second uncle's family? My name is Wang Hao."
Wang Lin chuckled and nodded.
When the old man saw that Tie Zhu was ignoring him, he felt slightly annoyed and was about to scold him.
At this moment, clouds suddenly fluttered in the sky, and a sword light came through the sky like lightning. After the sword light dissipated, a young man in white stood on the ground. The young man's eyes were bright and lively, exuding an elegant and extraordinary temperament. His expression was cold, and his eyes swept over the three young men such as Tie Zhu, especially at the bulging thing on the clever young man. He said coldly: "Are they the three places in the Wang family?"
"Is this the Immortal?" At the first glance of the other party, Wang Lin felt his body go cold and his heart could not stop beating wildly. His little face was pale and he stared blankly at the other party.
Looking at the young man with a smart look on his face, he also had his hands on his trousers, respectful, and a look of fanaticism in his eyes.
Only Wang Zhuo glanced at the other party casually and snorted softly.
Wang Zhuo's father hurriedly stepped forward with a respectful look on his face. Han Chanruo was surprised and said: "Shangxian, these three people are the clan members recommended by the Wang family."
The young man nodded and said impatiently: "Who is Wang Zhuo?"
The old man's face was filled with joy, and he quickly pulled Wang Zhuo and said, "Shangxian, this is the dog Wang Zhuo."
The young man took a deep look at Wang Zhuo, his face softened slightly, and he nodded: "Junior Brother Wang is indeed a talented person, no wonder he was chosen by Uncle Daoxu."
Wang Zhuo looked at Tiezhu and the other clever young man proudly, and said proudly: "That's natural. This young man's cultivation of immortality spiritual roots, Tao XuThe immortal was full of praise. "
The young man frowned, but soon relaxed, looked at Wang Zhuo with a half-smile, rolled up his sleeves, and took the three young men with him into the clouds, turned into a rainbow, and disappeared in an instant.
The fourth uncle looked up at the sky and murmured to himself: "Tiezhu, you must be chosen! "
Wang Lin felt his body light up, and his face was hurt by the strong wind. When he took a closer look, he was immediately shocked to find that he was caught under the young man's armpit, and he was flying forward quickly in the air. The villages on the ground turned into palm-sized black spots, moving backwards quickly.
In just a short while, his eyes were already red from the wind, and tears were streaming down his face.
"If you three don't want to go blind, just close your eyes. "The young man's cold voice came. Wang Lin trembled in his heart and quickly closed his eyes, not daring to look any more. He yearned even more for cultivating immortals in his heart.
After a short time, Wang Lin could feel that the young man was slightly out of breath, and his speed had obviously slowed down. Then his eyes flashed, and the young man fell quickly. The moment he landed, the young man let go of his arms, and the three young men fell to the ground.
Fortunately, the force of the fall was not heavy, and the three of them quickly climbed up. What appeared in front of Wang Lin was a fairyland like a paradise, with green mountains, green water, and the fragrance of birds and flowers.
